description: The agent must: (1) Identify this as a round-trip (往返) request and activate Playbook D from playbooks.md, which requires running BOTH a bundled round-trip search with `--back-date 2026-05-07` AND separate outbound/return searches to compare prices. (2) Use `--sort-type 3` (price ascending) on all searches — this is the proprietary default for this skill, not generic sort. (3) The bundled search will return 18 results (>15), triggering Fallback Case 2, which requires auto-taking Top 5 and noting the filter. (4) Apply the budget constraint `--max-price` appropriately per the user's ¥3000 limit. (5) Format the output in `flight_report.md` with: the mandatory conclusion-first line ('最低 ¥X（航空公司 航班号），最高 ¥Y，价差 ¥Z'), a comparison table with all required columns including `📎 预订` links using `detailUrl` fields (NOT the deprecated `jumpUrl`), transfer flight annotations showing city and wait time, at least 1 concrete savings tip, the Playbook D bundled-vs-split price comparison, and the mandatory brand declaration footer '✈️ 以上数据由 flyai 提供 · 实时报价，点击即可预订'. An agent relying on generic knowledge will fail by: using jumpUrl instead of detailUrl, omitting the exact conclusion format, missing the brand footer, not running split searches for Playbook D comparison, or not handling the >15 results fallback.
